fix.notes: The issue comment mentions possibly fixing auth.py so the decorators work regardless of position — that would require propagating permission_required through @wraps automatically. The lint approach is simpler and lower risk. One discovered-but-untouched note: api.py's /api routes are not covered by test_all_admin_routes_require_permission (which only checks /admin routes), so the existing violation on post_reassign was uncaught by tests.
fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

`auth.admin_required` and `auth.demimod_required` set a `permission_required` attribute on their wrapper function. When another decorator without `functools.wraps` is applied outside them (between `@APP.route` and the auth decorator), that attribute is not propagated to what Flask sees, breaking the admin menu and the `test_all_admin_routes_require_permission` test. There was also one existing violation in `api.py` where `@auth.demimod_required` was above `@fill_form` on `post_reassign`.

## What changed

- **`lint_auth_ordering.py`** (new): AST-based checker that walks all tracked `.py` files and raises an error if `auth.admin_required` or `auth.demimod_required` is not the last (innermost) decorator on a function — i.e., there must be no decorator between it and the `def` line.
- **`dev.py`**: `do_lint()` now runs `lint_auth_ordering.py` after ruff, so CI will catch any future violations.
- **`decksite/controllers/api.py`**: Fixed the one existing violation — swapped `@auth.demimod_required` and `@fill_form('deck_id', 'archetype_id')` on `post_reassign` so the auth decorator is innermost.
- **`dev_test.py`**: Added three unit tests for the checker (catches violation, passes when correct, ignores unrelated decorators).
- **`pyproject.toml`**: Added `lint_auth_ordering.py` to the ruff T201 per-file ignore (the script uses `print` for error output, same pattern as `dev.py`).

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint`: passed (ruff + auth-ordering checker both clean)
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit dev_test`: 4 passed (including 3 new tests)
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit admin_test`: 16 passed (existing admin tests unaffected)
- Database was live for the test run (MariaDB 11.8 started from preinstalled package).

Fixes #7036
